demand_forecast.scientific_rationale: Zero hospital admission, bed occupancy, ICU, testing volume, medicine stock, or health facility datasets exist in the project workspace. Converting disease cases into hospital admissions using fixed percentages and training a model on synthetic targets would violate scientific integrity. Therefore, empirical resource forecasting is disabled and the transparent Hypothetical Scenario Calculator fallback (Prompt 11 Section 5) is activated.
